title: Nidorino's Poison Gets Stronger When It Gets Angry
premise: Nidorino's poison becomes more potent as the adrenaline in its body rises.
audiencePromise: Follow Nidorino's warning signs from nervous tension to a stronger poison strike.
openLoop: What happens to Nidorino's poison when it senses danger?
payoff: Its bristling warning ends in a horn strike, while rising adrenaline makes the poison more potent.
engagementQuestion: Would you watch its ears, or fear the horn?

voice.instructions: Speak with tense curiosity. Start sharp, then build urgency as Nidorino senses danger. Slow slightly on the poison reveal. Keep the final question challenging.

scenes.headline: THE ANGRIER, THE STRONGER
scenes.narration: Nidorino's poison gets stronger while it gets angrier.
scenes.caption: ANGER → STRONGER POISON

scenes.headline: ITS EARS START THE WARNING
scenes.narration: First, it raises its big ears and checks its surroundings.
scenes.caption: BIG EARS CHECK THE AREA

scenes.headline: EVERY BARB BRISTLES
scenes.narration: Sense something hostile, and every barb on its back bristles.
scenes.caption: HOSTILE PRESENCE → BARBS BRISTLE

scenes.headline: ADRENALINE RAISES POTENCY
scenes.narration: Then it attacks, while rising adrenaline makes its poison more potent.
scenes.caption: ADRENALINE ↑  POISON POTENCY ↑

scenes.headline: THE HORN RELEASES POISON
scenes.narration: A horn stab makes the poison leak out on impact.
scenes.caption: HORN IMPACT → POISON LEAKS

scenes.headline: WHICH WARNING MATTERS MORE?
scenes.narration: Would you watch its ears, or fear the horn?
scenes.caption: WATCH THE EARS OR FEAR THE HORN?
